title: gentianella pilosa subsp. degenii
intro: Gentianella pilosa subsp. degenii, commonly known as Degen's gentian, is a rare alpine plant that belongs to the gentian family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella pilosa subsp. degenii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides, such as gentiopicroside and swertiamarine, that have been traditionally used to treat digestive issues and promote liver function. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Gentianella pilosa subsp. degenii for medicinal use.
